facts.fact: Vero 独坐精神病院屋顶，认定一切都是他的错
Vero 抓住 Kayla 两句矛盾真话中对他有利的那句，拒绝下来
facts.anchor: She also said she would never want me to leave, not for any reason

facts.fact: Ares 在屋顶下提醒另一句话同样存在
facts.anchor: She also told you to get out of her life

facts.fact: 噪音再起时 Vero 望向玉米地的 Cave，闪过让一切停止的念头
facts.anchor: Maybe I should have paid him a visit; he could have stopped all the noise in my head

facts.fact: Vesper 上屋顶戳破 Vero 的挑选性相信：两句都是真的
facts.anchor: Both things can be true. You don’t get to pick one and ignore the other

facts.fact: Vesper 把 Vero 踹落屋顶，Karo 早备好软垫——全员合谋的温柔救援
facts.anchor: She knew I wasn’t coming down

facts.fact: Brawley 告诉 Vero 今晚修不好，先带他回家
Brawley 以两人独有的方式把 Vero 拉回身体，说出「别再消失」
